summary.result: It was concluded that the use of NT method on agricultural fields could reduce soil erosion and muddy runoff significantly and help improve the water quality and aquatic ecosystem.
summary.background: The objective of this research was to experimentally test the effect of tillage methods on the reduction of runoff, non-point source (NPS) pollution load, sediment and discharge under a rainfall simulation.
summary.method: The NT and CT-RSB methods have a great possibility of reducing runoff and NPS pollution loads.
